name: Taskhold
description: For developers who hand work to Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, Taskhold is a hosted task list that you and your agents share. Official Taskhold remote MCP server: agents pick up the next task, plan it in steps, report progress on a live board, block with a question when they need you and complete with a summary. OAuth with dynamic client registration: a client connects as a guest with no sign-up, and the first tool call returns a link to start a 7-day trial ($12/month; paid plan only).
author: Taskhold
